hooks.command: [ "${GRAPHIFY_SESION:-1}" = 0 ] && exit 0; [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md" ] || exit 0; if [ "$OS" = Windows_NT ]; then set -- python py; else set -- python3 python; fi; for p in "$@"; do command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/motor/graphify/sesion_inicio.py"; done; exit 0

[ "${GRAPHIFY_GUARDIA:-1}" = 0 ] && exit 0; [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/graphify-out/graph.json" ] || exit 0; if [ "$OS" = Windows_NT ]; then set -- python py; else set -- python3 python; fi; for p in "$@"; do command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/motor/graphify/hook_guard.py" search; done; exit 0

[ "${GRAPHIFY_GUARDIA:-1}" = 0 ] && exit 0; [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/graphify-out/graph.json" ] || exit 0; if [ "$OS" = Windows_NT ]; then set -- python py; else set -- python3 python; fi; for p in "$@"; do command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/motor/graphify/hook_guard.py" read; done; exit 0
